description: [USER ONLY] Submit a new policy version. Must carry the user's wallet EIP-191 signature over the policy document; accepted only after signature + version-chain checks pass. Agents MUST NOT call this tool.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier for agent-scoped policy or attribution
agent_id.title: Agent Id

created_at.description: Policy creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds
created_at.title: Created At

nl_rule.description: Natural-language spending rule to compile and enforce
nl_rule.title: Nl Rule

owner.description: Owner wallet address that scopes policy, budget and audit state
owner.title: Owner

prev_hash.description: Previous policy hash, or 64 zero characters for a genesis policy
prev_hash.title: Prev Hash

scope.description: Policy scope: user for the owner default or agent for one agent
scope.title: Scope

signature.description: Owner wallet EIP-191 signature over the policy document
signature.title: Signature

name: set_policy
